Description: CloudHub T01-T09; operator-controlled Regions and language context

SshCidr.Description: Approved IPv4 network /24 or narrower for SSH, configured by operator

PostgresVersion.Description: Approved RDS PostgreSQL version in the chosen region

ApprovedImage.Description: Reviewed own-account ECR digest for T06; required when enabling T06

AlertEmail.Description: Approved operator email. Recipient must confirm SNS subscription.

ActualCostsEnabled.Description: Enable manual Cost Explorer queries after operator reviews API charges and activates cloudhub:environment cost allocation tag.

EnableRegionalT07.Description: Opt in to reviewed T07-only S3 permissions in Tokyo/Virginia. Does not enable template verification gates.

RegionsJson.Description: Operator-reviewed Region matrix. New Regions default disabled.

DriverRegionsJson.Description: Explicit regional AMI/network/backup profiles; no home identifiers inherited.

RegionsParameter.Description: Optional control-Region SSM Standard parameter, replaces inline JSON.

DriverRegionsParameter.Description: Optional control-Region SSM Standard parameter, replaces inline JSON.

RegionalPricesParametersJson.Description: Region to control-Region SSM Standard price parameter path. Each Region has separate prices.

UiEdgeSecret.Description: Random origin-only secret. Never include in public config or logs.

UiApiOriginDomain.Description: Existing API hostname from ApiUrl output. Set after initial creation to avoid Cognito/CloudFront dependency cycle.

ApplicationBootstrapPermissionsEnabled.Description: Explicit operator approval only: tagged reviewed-app EC2 bootstrap updates in Singapore. Does not enable an application or another Region.

RecommendationsEnabled.Description: Enable only after workers/ledger understand planning_workload. Does not publish performance evidence.

BenchmarksBucket.Description: Existing private operator artifact bucket. No bucket is created; API access must already be scoped to benchmarks/v1/*.

RecommendationPolicyJson.Description: Operator planning policy, not performance evidence or a quota change. Snapshot observed quotas with date/source.

CloudFrontViewerPricesJson.Description: Reviewed global CloudFront PriceClass_100 envelope with source/version/date; not a replacement for regional origin prices.

UserNotificationEmailEnabled.Description: Opt-in user email topics only after scoped SNS IAM and cost approval. Separate from operator alerts.

NotificationFrontendOrigin.Description: Public frontend origin for links; required when user email is enabled. No token/query/path.

MaintenancePublicEnabled.Description: Enable admin-reviewed static maintenance notices only after the scoped one-object S3 permission is reviewed.

ApiSnapStart.Description: Lambda SnapStart for the API function. Enabled removes most cold start time; Python SnapStart bills snapshot cache and restores (~6 USD/month at 1536 MB).

MonthlyBudgetUsd.Description: Actual monthly AWS cost budget for this account. 0 disables the budget and spend guard.

SpendGuardThresholdPercent.Description: Percent of MonthlyBudgetUsd (actual cost) at which new creations and renewals are frozen.

IdentityWafEnabled.Description: Attach a regional AWS WAF web ACL to the Cognito user pool (about 7 USD/month plus requests).
